### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused fixes have regression coverage and no blocking issues were identified; tests were not executed during review. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #26813 by preserving OpenAI autologging traces when function tools omit parameter properties. **Changes:** - Default missing tool properties to an empty dictionary. - Catch tool-schema validation errors without dropping traces. - Add regression coverage for sync/async calls and invalid schemas. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​openai/​test_openai_autolog.py` | Tests trace preservation and tool recording. | | `mlflow/​types/​chat.py` | Allows omitted parameter properties. | | `mlflow/​openai/​utils/​chat_schema.py` | Handles tool validation errors gracefully. |
Review effort: Balanced
